rationale: Removed all references to the `name` field from v1 construction and reads. The generated bindings will handle the reserved field correctly, so no explicit handling is needed for legacy payloads with field 2. The `entity_id` remains the only required field in v1.

No other implicit uses of `name` exist in the file beyond the explicitly flagged lines.
